title: CV: Education
text:
King's College London, London, UK. BSc (Hons) Mathematics with Statistics (from September 2024 to July 2027).
- Final-year modules (current): Statistical Inference, Time Series Analysis, Fundamentals of Probability Theory, Numerical & Computational Methods with Python, Theory of Complex Networks, Design of Experiments, Mathematical Finance I; final-year project on liquid neural networks.
- Earlier modules: Statistical Modelling, Probability & Statistics I & II, Applied Probability Models, Random Structures & Algorithms, Linear Algebra & Geometry I & II, Discrete Mathematics.

title: CV: Experience
text:
Oxford Dynamics, Harwell Science Campus, Oxfordshire. Visiting Student AI Researcher (from September 2026 to now).
- Leading research on liquid time-constant (LTC) networks as adaptive filters, run as Anmol's KCL final-year project in collaboration with Oxford Dynamics.
- Investigating whether the learned, input-dependent time constants of LTC networks correspond to the Kalman gain of an optimal linear filter, connecting continuous-time neural ODEs with classical state estimation.
Robotics Intern (from June 2026 to September 2026).
- Joined with no robotics background and learned the mechanics of a 6-DoF robotic arm.
- Picked up ROS 2 from scratch and built a controller for the arm in Python using ROS 2 and MoveIt.
- Recreated the arm in NVIDIA Isaac Sim while shadowing the company's research on vision-language-action models (VLAs) and vision-language models (VLMs).

title: CV: Leadership & Outreach
text:
Co-President, IBM Z Society & IBM Z Student Ambassador, KCL (from July 2025 to June 2026).
- Represented IBM Z on campus: hosted talks with Amazon engineers and an IBM director, ran workshops, and grew a mainframe learning community on IBM's Z Xplore platform.
Founder & President, KCL Financial Literacy Society (from January 2025 to May 2026).
- Founded a society teaching students practical personal finance, from budgeting to investing.
NMES Faculty Student Representative, KCL (from October 2025 to September 2026).
- Selected to represent NMES students; analysed about 150 survey responses and presented findings to staff.
Student Ambassador (Subject Ambassador & Online Events), KCL Mathematics (from November 2025 to September 2026).
- Presented to audiences of 20–60 at outreach events and helped run online Q&As and webinars for applicants.
Participant, King's Entrepreneurship Institute Online Incubator (August 2025).
Volunteer Python Instructor, Code Your Future (from August 2024 to January 2025).
